params.body:
## Why

An admin who saved their own staff record lost the admin role. The Beheerder checkbox on the staff edit form is disabled on your own record, a disabled checkbox is never posted, and `StaffMemberService::syncRoles` read the missing `isAdmin` as "not admin" and called `removeRole('admin')`. The redirect to `staff.show`, behind `role:admin|superadmin`, then answered 403. Any self-save did this; on 2026-10-23 it happened to an admin of athena Heule who filled in their own Smartschool username. The role was restored on prod by hand.

## What changes

- `syncRoles` leaves the acting user's own admin role as it is. Another admin or a superadmin still changes it.
- `create` and `update` run in one `DB::transaction`: a write that fails after the roles rolls them back with the rest.
- A Smartschool username already taken at the same account school (unique key on `users.username` + `account_school_id`) is a validation message on the field instead of a database error.

## Tests

Four new tests in `StaffMemberRoleManagementTest`, all failing on the old code: saving your own record keeps admin, posting `isAdmin=false` for yourself keeps admin, a colleague's admin role can still be removed, a taken username is a field error, a save that fails halfway changes nothing. Full suite on the workbench: 1360 passed, 21 failed, the same 21 that fail on plain `main` there (Vite manifest, build stamp, Chrome/PDF).

## Not in this PR

Admin is still one global spatie role scoped by `school_staff` links; `school_staff.admin` is not read anywhere. Making admin per school is a separate change.
params.title: Saving your own staff record no longer takes your admin role
